Response variable.reasoning: This column names the trait being measured for the focal organism.

Model.reasoning: This is a statistical model identifier, not a measurement of the organism.

Explanatory variable.reasoning: These are the independent variables used in the statistical model.

Estimate.reasoning: This column holds the calculated numerical estimate of the response variable.

Std.Error.reasoning: This column holds the standard error associated with the estimate.

lower CI.reasoning: This column holds the lower bound of the confidence interval.

upper CI.reasoning: This column holds the upper bound of the confidence interval.

z-value.reasoning: This column holds the calculated z-statistic for the model.

P.reasoning: This column holds the p-value for the statistical test.
